history.sg_progress: The Administration has identified a focal point and has started the training of the relevant staff members to monitor outstanding open items for early notification and to initiate recovery. A target date of the first quarter of 2025 has been set to complete a one-time review of all current open items for inactive staff and items open for more than 90 days for active staff. After the initial review of current open items, a monitoring report will be generated every 90 days to capture new items for continuous monitoring.
